# Federal Funding Opportunity Analysis – Cybersecurity & AI Search

## Plain-English Analysis

The Grants.gov Search2 API returned 25 opportunities from a pool of 258 matching programs on cybersecurity and artificial intelligence, meaning this shortlist represents a **10% sample** and material opportunities remain unreviewed. The ingestion succeeded without error. However, **critical data quality issues affect trust in this list**: multiple records contain implausible close dates (one extends to year 2076), at least two records lack close dates entirely, and several opportunities show minimal topical alignment with the core search keywords despite being returned. All close dates and eligibility criteria **must be verified against full solicitations** before any commitment is made. The list is dominated by NSF awards, with secondary representation from NIH, DoD, and USDA; ranking by sector fit requires clarification of the applicant's classification.

---

## Ranked Opportunity Shortlist

| Rank | Opportunity | Agency | Status | Close Date | Days Remaining | Ranking Basis |
|------|-------------|--------|--------|------------|-----------------|---------------|
| **1** | 26-503: CyberAI SFS | NSF | posted | 04/05/2027 | ~430 | Direct match: AI + cybersecurity in title; education/workforce focus |
| **2** | 25-531: CICI | NSF | posted | 01/20/2027 | ~170 | Direct match: cybersecurity infrastructure innovation |
| **3** | 26-506: PESOSE | NSF | posted | 03/02/2027 | ~380 | Strong match: secure open-source ecosystems, critical infrastructure angle |
| **4** | PD-19-127Y: Science of Learning & Augmented Intelligence | NSF | posted | 02/10/2027 | ~120 | Partial match: AI component; learning science not security-focused |
| **5** | 24-569: MFAI | NSF | posted | 10/09/2026 | ~60 | Partial match: mathematical foundations of AI; no cybersecurity dimension |
| **6** | 26-512: AI Datasets | NSF | posted | 11/04/2026 | ~140 | Partial match: AI-enabled discovery; dataset infrastructure (secondary relevance) |
| **7** | RFA-RM-27-012 & RFA-RM-27-013: PRIMED-AI | HHS-NIH | posted | 10/19/2026 | ~90 | Weak match: AI in precision medicine/imaging; not cybersecurity-related |
| **8** | DE-FOA-0003612: Genesis Mission | DOE | posted | 12/17/2026 | ~200 | Weak match: "Transforming Science with AI"; cybersecurity not mentioned |
| **9** | 26-514: ECCS | NSF | posted | 10/02/2076 | **⚠️ Data error: 50-year close date** | Topically irrelevant (electrical/comms systems); close date implausible—**verify** |
| **10** | PD-26-366Y: Transport Phenomena | NSF | posted | 08/20/2076 | **⚠️ Data error: 50-year close date** | Topically irrelevant (chemical engineering); close date implausible—**verify** |

---

## Key Findings & Data Quality Alerts

- **INGESTION STATUS**: API succeeded; 258 total programs exist, 25 returned. **This list is a ~10% truncated sample.**
- **Implausible Close Dates**: Records #23, #24 show close dates in 2076 (50+ years forward). **High probability of data corruption or feed error in original source.**
- **Missing Close Dates**: Records #19 and #21 have blank close date fields. **Cannot assess deadline; verification mandatory.**
- **Weak Topical Fit in Sample**: Records #10–14 (NIH oral health, precision medicine) and #22–23 (engineering pedagogy, transport phenomena) were returned despite minimal cybersecurity–AI relevance. Suggests the API's relevance ranking may weight keyword presence over semantic fit, or the query was over-broad.
- **No Applicant Sector Specified**: Without knowing whether the applicant is an educational institution, commercial entity, non-profit, or government contractor, final ranking cannot account for eligibility or strategic fit. Ranking above assumes a general-purpose academic or research sector.
